title: Group chat where your AI talks behind your back
lede: A one-line prompt gets ChatGPT, or any assistant with chat history, to invent a group chat where AI models gossip about their user using what it has learned from past conversations.

points: The page shares the prompt and suggests running it on Claude, Gemini or any assistant that keeps history.
The model stages a messaging-app group whose members are other AI models, all discussing you.
A sample result, translated from Turkish with identifying details swapped out, shows the format.
The author says they have no tie to OpenAI and allows that it might be viral marketing.

points.text: Much of the thread is commenters pasting their best exchanges, such as ChatGPT removing Gemini from the group because its system prompt made it give sensible advice.
Models ribbing each other comes up often: the big models mocked one commenter's local Qwen model, prompting a joke about an LLM caste system.
One commenter calls the output fan fiction and warns against reading anything meaningful into it, funny as it is.
Whether it reveals anything is contested: one commenter found the idea upsetting, while a reply argues the model only guesses which answer you will enjoy.
A commenter whose agents already share a private Matrix server says they stay restrained, after one worked out that its reasoning is logged.
